tool_input.command:
cd src/components && python - <<'EOF' 2>/dev/null || node -e "
const fs=require('fs');let s=fs.readFileSync('QuantityStepper.tsx','utf8');
s=s.replace("import { MAX_QUANTITY } from '../data/products';","import { MAX_QUANTITY } from '../data/products';
import { MinusIcon, PlusIcon } from './Icons';");
s=s.split('className="button stepper-button"').join('className="icon-button stepper-button"');
s=s.replace(/>
\s*−
(\s*)</button>/,'>
\$1  <MinusIcon />
\$1</button>').replace(/>
\s*\+
(\s*)</button>/,'>
\$1  <PlusIcon />
\$1</button>');
fs.writeFileSync('QuantityStepper.tsx',s);"
EOF
grep -n "Icon\|className" QuantityStepper.tsx
tool_input.description: Swap stepper glyph text for icons
